day1_insight: Recent rain (17 mm over the past few days) is washing urban runoff into the surf — the single biggest cause of beach contamination — especially near storm drains and creek mouths. The model's main signals right now: 17 mm of rain has fallen, washing bacteria-laden runoff into the surf; high tide timing is lowering risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; and strong sunlight is lowering risk by inactivating bacteria with UV. The most recent sample, 6 days ago, was excellent at 31 MPN/100mL.
